prompt: Which U.S. airline had the highest percentage of delayed flights over the full calendar year of 2024, according to the U.S. Department of Transportation's Air Travel Consumer Report?
answer: Frontier Airlines had the highest percentage of delayed flights in 2024. In the DOT’s January–December 2024 data, Frontier had the lowest on-time arrival rate among the reported U.S. airlines—so roughly one-third of its flights were delayed.
